summary: Iteration 19 frontend testing of new ProcessRackSection and SavingsSection on IT SMARTCLOUT landing page. All requested acceptance criteria verified against public URL. 45/45 checks passed after correcting my own test selectors (initial header selector missed sc-nav header element; hero uses id='top' by design as request states 'hero(top)').
critical_code_review_comments: ProcessRackSection.jsx: RACK_UNITS uses duplicate 'key' values ('server' twice, 'switch' twice) but React iterates with idx as key so it works; consider unique ids for clarity.
Two rack-unit-server-* both get is-active when 'design' step is clicked because filter is by kind, not by index — this is intentional per rack layout but worth noting.
SavingsSection.jsx: 'Kupujemy odsprzedajemy i redystrybuujemy' PL copy is missing a comma (minor copy issue).
Both new sections use useSectionParallax hook — verify not causing extra scroll listeners; no console errors observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 fully validated.
